answer: Chemo-spatial attestation curbs Sybil attacks in ecological agent networks. Candidate agents authenticate by sampling microclimate terpene plumes near a cedar canopy while synchronizing with a localized radio beacon. Each reading is signed inside an onboard secure vault, forcing attackers to deploy separate physical gas-spectrometry rigs and power cells per identity. However, unpredictable wind gusts disperse atmospheric vapor gradients, causing occasional false rejections of honest agents.
